# Version 4.159.0 (Unreleased)
> **Glyph and Vulkan hardening**

## Highlights

Upcoming Skia m159 fixes harden mask-filtered glyph rendering and Imagination Vulkan allocation failure handling.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Mask-filtered glyphs handle changing scaler output** — Uses the reloaded glyph's path when successive font-scaler loads disagree. Incompatible masks are cleared instead of copied, and clipped embossed masks retain full plane strides, avoiding stale outlines, sub-byte buffer overwrites and corrupted mask planes. ([#5741](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5741))
- **Imagination Vulkan allocation failures avoid unsafe cleanup** — Ganesh and Graphite abandon descriptor pools after host or device out-of-memory allocation errors on Imagination drivers, where destroying the pool can trigger a driver failure. Graphite also prevents further allocation through the abandoned handle. ([#5741](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5741))
